evidence.notes: Scope honoured: this groom writes only docs/issues/t58.md, its byte-identical mirror docs/issues/groom/t58.md, the machine-readable worklist docs/state/outputs/t58_gap_manifest.json and this handoff. No generator, test, report or application file is touched; scratch/ holds throwaway build helpers and is not committed. Residual risk disclosed in the card: post-merge inertness rests on the card naming no evidence id in full form plus the ac6 staging proof; if a later card adds a document to the citation universe that re-points one of these 97 rows, ac1's byte-identity leg fails loudly rather than silently and t59 re-grooms from that signal. A second residual: ac5's per-file line floors are absolute numbers derived from the base file lengths plus a per-id allowance, so a builder who closes the ids with unusually terse prose could miss a floor for style rather than substance - the floors exist precisely to block one-line citation spam, and each is paired with a substance-token check and a per-file mention ceiling.
